resourceName: Huinan County Improved Forest Management Project
description: Huinan County Afforestation Project is located in Huinan county, Tonghua city, Jilin province of China. The purpose of the project is to implemented by Jilin Huinan Forestry Bureau(hereafter“project owner”)to protect the once logging forest.The project avoids emissions by converting logged forests into projected forests,which will achieve sustainable carbon sequestration at the same time.This project aims to protect 13,922 ha commercial forest from logging. The implementation of the project will generate greenhouse gases (GHG) emission removals and mitigate climate change, improve soil and water conservation and forest cover, increase competence and capability of local residents by providing them with relevant technical skills and training, and create more permanent job opportunities for local residents especially women and increase income for local communities.  The project is estimated to generate GHG emission removals of 5,539,094.55 tCO2e in 30 years, with an average annual GHG emission removal of 184,636.48 tCO2e.
